fingerprint.structure: 4 to 6 slides: hook object grid (6 causes or signs) → 1 to 3 more object grids (swaps to eat, what makes it worse, what actually fixes it) → text explainer slide (mechanism in 2 short paragraphs + first-person app plug) → full-bleed lifestyle photo with a body-outcome promise and the app named as the bio link
fingerprint.hook: 'why X makes you Y' / 'foods that Y your Z' problem headline in serif, the payoff phrase in pink italic, a small grey subheading that reframes it ('its water, not fat', 'eat them at night, see them at 8am'); the 6-object grid under it is the visual hook (you scan it for things you ate today)
fingerprint.camera_motion: other:designed-card. Cream card (#faf8f4), 2 x 3 grid of photoreal product cut-outs with soft drop shadows, each with a bold label and a grey one-line reason; explainer slide is text only; the closer is humans (warm, film-look lifestyle or selfie photo of one or two smiling women, no face of the creator)
fingerprint.pacing: slideshow; grid slides carry 13 to 14 short text items (heading, subheading, 6 labels, 6 reasons); explainer 50 to 70 words; closer 2 lines
fingerprint.text_overlay: headline: Playfair Display-like serif, dark brown-black, lowercase, about 4% of frame height, centred top; the second half of the headline in pink (#d4508a range) italic of the same serif; labels: Inter-like sans semibold dark, reasons: same sans, small, grey; explainer: serif heading with pink italic, a pink '...' divider, sans body centred, app name in pink bold; closer: white serif headline with pink italic half over the lower third of the photo, white sans subline
fingerprint.audio: trending or 'original sound' music track, no voiceover
fingerprint.arc: recognition (you ate these) → reassurance (it's water or habit, not fat or failure) → easy swaps and habits → mechanism that makes it make sense → 'it worked for me and the app is how it stuck' → aspirational outcome photo

product: two slots, always the last two slides: the explainer's last paragraph is a first-person testimonial that names '75 Evi app' in pink bold as how the habit stuck; the closer's subline says the app is the link in bio. Product never appears in the grids
proof_device: none (first-person testimonial only, no screenshots or numbers)
series: single posts, but one account-wide series look (every post is this template)
caption: one lowercase sentence restating the hook as a reassurance or reveal ('a jawline that disappears overnight is fluid, not fat. this is where it went') + 'link in bio 🤍' + 4 to 6 hashtags; no punctuation except commas and full stops, no apostrophes
hashtags: 4 to 6: symptom words (#puffyface #waterretention #constipation), community tags (#wellnesstok #wellnessgirl), outcome tags (#flatstomach)
language: English, second person in the grids, first person in the testimonial; calm, knowing, 'big sister' tone; lowercase; apostrophes dropped (youre, its, doesnt)
notes: hook grid labels numbered 1 to 6 (a ranking); the 'what actually helps/fixes' grid usually hides 1 to 3 absurd items (e.g. 'Clap 3 times before water / Every glass', 'Light a candle before eating', 'Set your alarm for 6:57 / Never 7:00', 'Face east for breakfast / Not a joke') as comment bait among real habits
